_about: Region names for the Oxford connectivity-based areas, taken from the source papers' own text.
Each entry: aka = the name added to the area (e.g. 'Right Area 14m - vmPFC'), quote = the paper's words it rests on, where = section.
Areas with no entry are ones the paper does not place in a named larger region (or whose name already is one, e.g. SMA, FPl, TPJa).
Keys: the source ('Neubert', 'Sallet', 'Mars') and the area as the app writes it, without the side.
Edit freely, then rebuild: atlaslookup add-cbp <the parcellation zips>.
